meta.name: goal
meta.description: Autonomous objective-pursuit executor — decomposes an objective into Six Slots and a Story set, dispatches execution to sisyphus, then re-pursues the objective across plan/execute cycles until an objective-level completion gate confirms the verification surface is met.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动将目标分解为可执行计划并循环执行直至完成
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你有一个复杂目标需要自动分解并执行
copy.tagline_en: Automatically decompose goals into executable plans and iterate until completion
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automatically break down and pursue a complex objective

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会将用户提出的一个可验证目标自动分解为六个槽位和一套故事，然后反复计划、执行，直到满足完成条件。它不会假装完成——每次写状态失败都会继续追求或阻塞。
howto.when: 当用户提出一个可被机器检验的目标（如测试、基准、特定工件），且当前没有其他活跃目标时触发。如果目标是续期，会列出候选目标供选择。

say.text: 请实现一个函数，能通过给定的单元测试。
say.note: Claude 会分解目标并开始自主循环执行。
Claude 会列出之前的候选目标供选择。

say.text: 把这段代码的性能提升到基准线以上。
say.note: 需附带可检验的基准，否则会要求澄清。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude decomposes a falsifiable user objective into six slots and a story set, then autonomously plans and executes in cycles until completion is verified. It never false-completes; any write failure degrades to continue-pursuit or block.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user provides a falsifiable objective (e.g., a test, benchmark, artifact) and no other active goal exists. If continuation is indicated, Claude lists candidate goals for user selection.

say_en.text: Implement a function that passes the given unit tests.
say_en.note: Claude will decompose the objective and begin autonomous pursuit.
Claude lists previous goal candidates to choose from.

say_en.text: Optimize this code above the baseline benchmark.
say_en.note: Requires a verifiable benchmark; otherwise requests clarification.
